questions.prompt: How do you add 2 new units to a deployed application named 'web' on a machine cloud?
questions.explanation: 'juju add-unit <app> -n <count>' scales out the application by adding new units.

questions.prompt: Which command removes a specific unit named 'worker/1' from the model?
questions.explanation: 'juju remove-unit <unit-name>' removes the targeted unit and cleans up its machine.

questions.prompt: Which command is used for direct scale-to-count operations on Kubernetes container models?
questions.explanation: 'juju scale-application' is used on Kubernetes models to set an exact replica count.
